body.p:
The Unstaged files area lists changed resources that are not part of the next commit. These resources can include modified files, new files, and deleted files. Review this list to decide which changes belong in the next commit.
To inspect a changed resource, double-click it or use Open in compare editor from the contextual menu.
To prepare files for commit, move them to the Staged files area. You can use Stage all to stage all files, or select specific files and use Stage selected.
To switch between the list view and tree view, click the Switch to tree/list view button.
The contextual menu also includes actions such as Open, Stage, Discard, Show history, Show blame, and Show in Explorer (Show in Finder on macOS).
